response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/software craftsman with impressive breadth (web, mobile, embedded C/C++, DLang), but he lacks the two hard requirements for this role: native-level Japanese proficiency (only English, Romanian, and basic German are listed) and any demonstrated experience with Linux kernel source modification, security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X), or LAN-switch/embedded networking products. His recent and most substantial experience is in web/full-stack and cloud-native development, not embedded systems security.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering career with senior/staff-level titles and strong ownership of projects
Solid low-level and systems programming background (C/C++ at National Instruments, DLang high-performance async I/O work)
Demonstrated ability to learn and contribute across many domains (hardware, embedded, web, mobile)
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed, which is an absolute requirement for this role
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No exposure to required security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, captive portal, tamper detection) or switch/networking chip work

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security experience
Strong general software engineering and C/embedded background
